To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve had the pleasure of collaborating with Elena Popescu on a few projects at [Agency Name], where she served as a Backend Engineer at NexaCloud Solutions. Our interactions were occasional but meaningful, centered around integrating SaaS platforms with client systems. Elena’s approach to problem-solving and attention to detail left a clear impression.  

Elena’s strength lies in her ability to design REST APIs that balance simplicity with scalability. At NexaCloud, she restructured a legacy API endpoint to reduce latency by 30% without compromising security, which directly improved client onboarding times. She also prioritizes clarity in documentation, ensuring teams across time zones can troubleshoot issues quickly. Beyond technical skills, she’s reliably proactive—once, she identified a potential AWS region outage hours before it occurred, enabling her team to reroute traffic and avoid 99.95% uptime loss.  

One standout moment was during a high-stakes migration to a microservices architecture. Elena led the decomposition of a monolithic service into modular components, which cut deployment complexity by half. Her willingness to iterate and explain trade-offs kept the team aligned despite tight deadlines.  

Elena is reliable, collaborative, and deeply focused on outcomes. Her work ethic and technical precision make her a strong fit for roles requiring both architectural thinking and hands-on execution.  

Sincerely,
